question: Komal is the daughter of Mrs. Suman and Sonam is the daughter of Mr. Kamal. If Rajaram is the father-in-law of Suman and husband of Surekha, who is the mother of her only child Kamal. How is Komal related to Sonam?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e8347de0818cebd110ad3e3272df28c199f2b0638f7faed2a2143c4c56a5ed1.png] 

Drawing the family tree,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1f7d4f62d48241ad6897938bb96054903ac2c33b8b123fbdbf61d1714abf21d.png] 

Komal is the sister to Sonam.

Hence, “sister” is the correct answer.
